summary: Frontend-only regression for VERA OS Alquileres: notification bell panel fix (position:fixed), reserva_proxima reminder, visible 'Recibo PDF' button, mark-all-read and outside-click close. All 4 scenarios PASSED.

test_results.1_notif_panel_visible: PASS - Panel opens fully visible at box {x:1560, y:60, w:340, h:756}, well within viewport 1920x1080. Not clipped by topbar overflow:hidden anymore (position:fixed working).
test_results.2_reserva_proxima_notification: PASS - Item 'Reserva próxima' with text 'Check-in en 2 días (16/08/2026) · Reserva Proxima Test · CASA DE PRUEBA — Costa del Este (borrar)' visible in panel. Click navigates to /alquileres correctly.
test_results.3_recibo_pdf_button: PASS - In Reservas tab (rt-tab-res), 3 clear buttons with text 'Recibo PDF' visible (data-testid rt-recibo-<id>) for Marta ConfirmTest, Carlos Test and Ana Huésped. All are <A> tags with href pointing to /api/rentals/reservations/<id>/recibo-sena (correct endpoint).
test_results.4_mark_all_and_outside_close: PASS - POST /api/notifications/read-all returned 200. Clicking outside panel closes it (panel.is_visible()=False after outside click).

seed_data_creation: None; used pre-existing reservations (Reserva Proxima Test, Carlos Test, Ana Huésped, Marta ConfirmTest).
